titles.romaji: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Christmas da! Minna Atsumare
titles.native: それいけ！アンパンマン クリスマスだ！みんな集まれ

description:
Christmas has come again, and Anpanman and his friends have all gathered to prepare for some kind of grand effort - but Baikinman, without even knowing the details, will do everything he can to get in the way!

Released in the collection Sore Ike! Anpanman: Uta to Ohanashi - Suteki na Christmas, as a double feature with the home video release of the Anpanman TV anime's 1994 Christmas episode.
